description.en: Native Zipformer2 RNN-T transcription for the public free Kroko Community single-language packages, with offline and stateful streaming inference, greedy and modified beam decoding, hotwords, endpoint segments, partial results, and word timestamps.
description.zh: 为公开免费的 Kroko Community 单语言包提供的原生 Zipformer2 RNN-T 转写，支持离线与有状态流式推理、贪心与改进束解码、热词、端点分段、部分结果与词级时间戳。

language.en: Language code matching the selected single-language Kroko package; default auto uses the package language.
language.zh: 与所选单语言 Kroko 包匹配的语言代码；默认 auto 使用该包的语言。

hotwords.en: Slash- or newline-separated natural-text phrases; requires modified beam search.
hotwords.zh: 以斜杠或换行分隔的自然语言短语；需要改进型 beam 搜索。

decoding_method.en: RNN-T decoding method; greedy search remains the parity-tested default.
decoding_method.zh: RNN-T 解码方法；贪心搜索仍是经过一致性测试的默认值。

num_beams.en: Maximum active hypotheses retained by modified beam search.
num_beams.zh: 修改版 beam search 保留的最大活跃假设数。

blank_penalty.en: Non-negative score subtracted from the RNN-T blank logit.
blank_penalty.zh: 从 RNN-T blank logit 中减去的非负分数。

hotwords_score.en: Non-negative per-token context boost for hotword phrases.
hotwords_score.zh: 热词短语的逐 token 非负上下文加权。

enable_endpoint.zh: 启用自动端点语音分段。

rule1_min_trailing_silence_sec.en: Endpoint timeout in seconds even when no speech token was decoded.
rule1_min_trailing_silence_sec.zh: 即使未解码到语音 token，端点超时也按该秒数触发。

rule2_min_trailing_silence_sec.en: Endpoint silence in seconds after a speech token was decoded.
rule2_min_trailing_silence_sec.zh: 解码到语音 token 后，端点静音秒数。

rule3_min_utterance_length_sec.en: Maximum utterance duration in seconds before an endpoint.
rule3_min_utterance_length_sec.zh: 触发端点前的最大话语时长（秒）。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=report peak (docs/reports)
